page_title: The AI Assistant That Actually Does the Work

sources.entry: AI Assistant for SMBs: Managed AI assistant service for small businesses that executes work autonomously - handles calls, emails, reports, bookings. Integrates with business tools, learns workflows, runs 24/7.

summary.name: AI Assistant for SMBs (OpenClaw)
summary.one_liner: A managed AI assistant service for small businesses that carries out tasks such as sending emails, updating CRMs, and posting content rather than only drafting them, based on a case study of entrepreneur Dan Course.
use_cases: Sending client emails and updating a CRM automatically
Scheduling and posting social media content
Running market research and validating business ideas
Producing short video content with less manual effort
Handling routine business tasks while the owner is away
summary.what_it_does: The page promotes a managed AI assistant that executes work rather than only writing drafts, according to the vendor. Per the page, it connects to business tools (the case study names Netlify, Notion, Reddit/YouTube APIs, GitHub and Google Drive), runs through Telegram, and spawns specialized agents for tasks such as research, growth and video production. It is described as running 24/7 and maintaining context and preferences over time. The case study claims one user went from 1-2 projects to five businesses with the same 15 hours per week, but these results are self-reported. The page also lists pricing tiers, including a £299/month plan.
notable: Executes tasks end to end (e.g. email sent, CRM updated, follow-up scheduled) instead of drafting
Spawns parallel specialized agents for research, growth, and video production
Flat team pricing with no per-seat fees, and a stated 48-hour setup
Integrates directly with tools such as Notion, GitHub, Netlify and Google Drive
caveats: Paid service: listed at £299/month for the best-value plan, with a £1,300/month tier and a £60/user/mo comparison plan also shown
Page says only 10 early customers are available at this pricing
Case study results (5 businesses, £127 MRR, 3-5x productivity) are self-reported by the vendor and its founder
